bugs.description: Customer record is not created (and therefore policy_accepted_at is not persisted) until the book tool is called. With max_turns=8 the flow reaches name collection but not booking confirmation. The scenario expects outcome=policy_accepted with DB evidence, but the customer row does not exist at turn 8 (still collecting notes). policy_accepted_at: null, customer_consents: empty. This is a scenario design vs. implementation gap — the schema stores policy at booking time, not at verbal acceptance time.
